# InstiSupply

> InstiSupply is a Dubai-based institutional supplies business serving organisations across the United Arab Emirates.

## Core product categories
- Stationery & Paper: https://instisupply.com/stationery-paper.html
- Printer & IT Consumables: https://instisupply.com/printer-it-consumables.html
- Hygiene & Tissue: https://instisupply.com/hygiene-tissue.html
- Cleaning & Janitorial: https://instisupply.com/cleaning-janitorial.html
- Pantry & Disposables: https://instisupply.com/pantry-disposables.html
- PPE & Safety: https://instisupply.com/ppe-safety.html
- Food Packaging Supplies: https://instisupply.com/food-packaging-supplies.html

## Primary pages
- Home: https://instisupply.com/

- Privacy: https://instisupply.com/privacy.html

## Business context
InstiSupply serves institutional and B2B buyers including education, healthcare, corporate offices, facilities management, industrial/worksite environments, supermarkets, grocery retail and food-service operations in the UAE. Product brands, pack sizes, specifications, availability, pricing and delivery terms are confirmed at quotation stage.
